page: Microsoft Azure E32ds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Edsv6 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 16 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8573C processor operating at a clock speed of 4.2 GHz. The x86_64 architecture includes 260 MB of L3 cache, 2 MB of L2 cache per core, and 48 KB of L1d cache. Memory capacity is 256.0 GB, providing an 8.0 GB per core ratio. The instance includes 1890 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and is Premium Storage capable, though it does not bundle any complimentary public IPv4 addresses or GPUs.

Benchmark results indicate strong memory and processing capabilities. The server achieves a strong rating in large-block read-only memory bandwidth at 208.86 GB/sec and a top-tier rating in LLM inference text generation for small models at 373.84 tokens/sec. Single-threaded gzip compression at 31.38 GB/sec and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression at 199.59 GB/sec also place in the top 25 percent. Geekbench scores are strong, with a single-core score of 2120.0 and a multi-core score of 17689.0. Standard database operations, Redis SET performance at 43.91 million operations per second, and multi-core stress-ng benchmarks remain in the average tier.

Given its high memory-to-vCPU ratio and integrated high-speed local NVMe storage, the E32ds_v6 provides high resource density for memory-bound workloads without requiring external storage attachments for temporary data. This hardware profile is highly suited for relational database management systems, in-memory caching layers, data analytics, and medium-scale language model inference.
